links.outcome: Error detection rate of LLMs against known inserted errors in radiology reports
links.quote: Closed-source LLMs achieved higher error detection rates than open-source LLMs (GPT-4o: 88% [348/397; 95% CI: 86, 92], GPT-4: 83% [328/397; 95% CI: 80, 87], Llama 3-70b: 79% [311/397; 95% CI: 76, 83], Mixtral 8x22b: 73% [288/397; 95% CI: 68, 77]; p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Locally hosted open-source LLMs as privacy-compliant alternative to commercial closed-source LLMs for report error detection

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the error detection performance of open-source vs. closed-source LLMs on a synthetic benchmark dataset of radiology reports.
